verdict.rationale: The MI325X is a datacenter AI/HPC accelerator: an OAM module on the CDNA3 compute architecture, deployed in 8-GPU servers and managed through ROCm, Kubernetes and Slurm tooling. High-refresh 4K gaming is not a question buyers of this kind of product would ask, so the axis does not apply. Nothing in the evidence shows the product shipping gaming capability that would make the axis applicable.
